mapper.sql: SELECT m.id, m.code, m.name, m.spec, m.unit, m.category, m.batch_enabled, m.serial_enabled, m.safety_stock, m.status, m.remark, p.supply_type, COALESCE(p.supply_type, CASE WHEN b.id IS NULL THEN 'BUY' ELSE 'MAKE' END) AS effective_supply_type, p.lead_days, p.min_lot, p.lot_multiple, COALESCE(p.over_issue_rate, 0) AS over_issue_rate, p.planner, COALESCE(p.fqc_required, 0) AS fqc_required, b.id AS bom_id, b.version AS bom_version, b.lead_days AS bom_lead_days, sp.supplier_id, s.name AS supplier_name, sp.lead_days AS supplier_lead_days, sp.min_qty AS supplier_min_qty, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(st.qty), 0) FROM wms_stock st WHERE st.material_id = m.id) AS on_hand_qty, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mes_material_substitute x WHERE x.material_id = m.id) AS substitute_count FROM wms_material m LEFT JOIN mes_material_plan p ON p.material_id = m.id LEFT JOIN mes_bom b ON b.material_id = m.id AND b.is_default = 1 AND b.status = 1 LEFT JOIN scm_supplier_price sp ON sp.material_id = m.id AND sp.is_default = 1 LEFT JOIN scm_supplier s ON s.id = sp.supplier_id
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM mes_material_plan WHERE material_id IN #{id}

SELECT b.id AS bom_id, b.version, b.is_default, b.status AS bom_status, b.material_id AS product_id, p.code AS product_code, p.name AS product_name, i.qty, i.loss_rate FROM mes_bom_item i JOIN mes_bom b ON b.id = i.bom_id JOIN wms_material p ON p.id = b.material_id WHERE i.material_id = #{materialId} ORDER BY p.code, b.version
